notes.title: New Scenario Feature Update!
notes.notes:
Are you up for some challenges? 
Today we released our new scenario feature in Gaia Project. 
Beat 14 different scenarios and their 4 difficulty levels and gain unique rewards and achievements! 

This update also introduces a new way to customize your profile. Click on your Avatar in your profile to access it. We added new tabs that will display all profile avatars, frames, corners and badges you collected throughout our games.

Gaia Project is the first of our games to get this feature, and other games will follow. As soon as they are updated you will also be able to show your Gaia Project profile rewards in other games. 
Soon we want to celebrate these new features with you. So don’t forget to check our upcoming news on social media!

notes.title: Update 15
notes.notes:
Hello space travellers!
before we jump right into gaia projects patch notes, we would like to inform you that gaia project will be discounted during the Steam Board Game Event on October 21-25. For those who have an eye on the game - this is a great opportunity to grab it. 
There are also new feature updates coming up as we have the lobby working in our intern test already. 

Btw, for those who are interested in Viticulture... there are great news coming up for that game as well. We finished migrating the game to our new server to join Gaia Project. And we are having a redesign in progress. Stay tuned for more news.

And now... to the updates!

 fixed stuck AI in online games
 fixed alternative payment with gaia formers
 fixed taklons losing too many VP on passive power gain
 fixed multiple federation issues
 improved general performance on all devices
 improved in game loading time of history panel

notes.title: Update 13
notes.notes:
Dear space travellers, 

Update 13 just launched and brings along a community feature request: 

Retro structures on all UI elements.

Previously we added a retro view for the structures on the map, now they will also appear in all their nostalgic glory on the rest of the UI elements if you checked the "Retro Map" view in-game.

On another topic -
Some of our mac OS users reported that the game won't launch after the last update. After testing we figured that updating the mac to the latest OS should fix this issue. Please let us know if it worked for you. We'll keep an eye on this.


And now to the latest update and fix list:

- added retro structures to all UI elements
- improved faction and planetary institute ability graphics
- improved loading times
- fixed Nevlas power to credits exchange
- fixed Nevlas alternative payments
- fixed online bidding
- fixed AI bidding
- fixed Ivits satellite count
